method.conds: plain = the line as written; expressive = the engine's native control only (Omni inline style tags, MAI express-as, realtime/Nova prose note). No spliced clips, no <break>. Engines with no native control (DragonHD, Dragon hi-IN, Polly) have the plain take only.

method.screens: silence: ffmpeg silencedetect -45 dB / 0.35 s; asr: Azure STT hi-IN short-audio Lexical (asr-check.py), rough, English words dropped; defects: automated long-silence flag (>2.5 s internal gap) plus manual notes from the ASR transcripts. None of this replaces the blind page.
